title: Laboratory GHS Pictogram & Mixture Label Studio
description: A 100% client-side, zero-backend web application and Python CLI tool for generating Globally Harmonized System (GHS) / EU CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 chemical safety labels for laboratory buffers, mobile phases, and custom multi-component mixtures, featuring 38 inbuilt presets, optional live NCBI PubChem CAS lookup (with an Offline Mode toggle), calibrated physical label sizing, anti-clip A4 pagination, and 300-DPI PDF export.
